payload.root_cause: In slugify (src/text.js:11), the run-collapsing step `.replace(/[\s-]+/, '-')` uses a regex without the global flag `g`. String.prototype.replace with a non-global regex substitutes only the FIRST match. Consequently, only the first whitespace/dash run becomes a dash and every subsequent gap is left as raw whitespace. For 'Hello Big  World!': toLowerCase→'hello big  world!', the sanitizing replace `/[^a-z0-9\s-]/g` removes only '!' (it deliberately preserves whitespace), then the un-flagged replace converts just the space after 'hello' → 'hello-big  world', matching the failing actual value exactly. Adding `g` so all runs collapse (and runs of dashes collapse to a single dash) is the minimal fix; the adjacent regexes on lines 10 and 12 already carry `g`, so line 11 is the sole defect.
